choices.why: This light grey three-seater with clean, wide arms is exactly the colour asked for and suits the long left wall of a modern, bright living room.
The light beige shaggy rug defines the seating area and keeps the room bright, with a modern look that suits the grey wood-look floor.
This light ash coffee table with Scandinavian legs is the light wood requested, and its compact size leaves room to move in a long, narrow space.
The long, low white console on slim legs has open shelves for devices and blends into the white walls without weighing the room down.
The black arc lamp echoes the black frame of the balcony door and reaches over the sofa with warm light for evenings with friends.
A pair of abstract-print cushions in blue, pink and black adds colour and a modern touch to the grey sofa.
The tall, airy areca palm brings green next to the balcony and makes good use of the natural light.
The white sheer curtains soften the sliding door without blocking light, keeping the room luminous.

answer.why: A light palette of grey, white, beige and light wood keeps the room bright and modern. The black arc lamp picks up the frame of the balcony door, and the cushions and palm add the requested colour.
